title: Apple, Inc. Will Survive This Battery-Powered Drama, Too
text:
Apple, Inc. Will Survive This Battery-Powered Drama, Too 
In late December, phone enthusiasts figured out that Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) has been slowing down their older iPhones on purpose. Without any warning, and certainly with no control over a feature that many users don't want in the first place, recent versions of the iOS operating system will reduce the processing speed on iPhones with aging, degraded batteries.
